title: pm-dispatch landing-operations.md: the landing window does not point at the seat's log-first re-run duty in platform-readings.md
body:
domain:skills#3 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jULfPnqQFGcZUtKDFH

Filing gate: (b) a follow-up a review names. Contract review 6724702446 on PR #31620 (card #31582, merged 8784ccbce0), nit N3. ⛔ Not a claim.

## 维护者速读

#31582 把「红检查先读日志，基础设施失败由席位自己重跑，永不请维护者点」写进了 `platform-readings.md` 第 285–291 行。可席位落地时读的是 `landing-operations.md`，那里没有指向这几行的话，席位在落地窗口里可能想不起这条义务。这张卡只加一个指针，不改规则。

## What

- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/landing-operations.md` L28-29 (main 8784ccbce0) handle queue reds and "基上缺已合修复 ⇒ merge main"; nothing there names the PR-side infra-red duty or its three steps.
- The file is at its line ceiling (102/102, headroom 0), so the pointer must fold into an existing line (≤120 B) or pay by deletion of text restated elsewhere.

## Ask

- One pointer to `platform-readings.md`'s 红检查先读日志 lines from the landing window, without restating the steps.

## Not in scope

- Changing the re-run allowlist or the steps.

Related: #31582, PR #31620.
